fields.name: magic
fields.meaning: Save signature "CHAOS GEAR V1.00"; power-on wipes the save area when it mismatches
fields.evidence: code 5000:311a compares 8 words with ROM 5000:30fc; init 5000:3180 writes it; written at first power-on

fields.name: save_present
fields.meaning: 1 once the game has saved, 0 in a fresh/wiped area
fields.evidence: code 5000:3326 writes 1 in the save writer; 0 before vs 1 after saving

fields.name: army_count
fields.meaning: Number of army records in use (4 in the verified save)
fields.evidence: code 4000:6f1a wraps the turn index modulo this word; saved copy of work SRAM 0x3001

fields.name: army_records
fields.meaning: 12 records of 199 bytes (0xC7), one per army/town on the campaign map; record n at 0x0013+n*0xC7
fields.evidence: code indexes work 0x3003+n*199 (4000:2f22, 4000:3008, 4000:aa66, 4000:6f1a); 4 filled in the verified save

fields.name: table_a
fields.meaning: 32 records of 86 bytes (0x56); entity ids 0x01-0x3F index these (all empty in the verified save)
fields.evidence: code 4000:aa66 computes 0x3957+(id-1)*0x56; loops of 32 at 4000:aab4 and 4000:b94c

fields.name: table_b
fields.meaning: 32 records of 86 bytes; entity ids 0x81-0xBF index these (record 0 used in the verified save)
fields.evidence: code 4000:aa66 computes 0x4417+((id&0x3F)-1)*0x56; cursor search 4000:aa33

fields.name: flags_4ed7
fields.meaning: Eight flag bytes, all 1 (set when a new game starts; purpose unknown)
fields.evidence: set at new-game start; no code reference found

fields.name: player.money
fields.meaning: Player funds in G, capped at 9999
fields.evidence: code adds with 9999 cap (4000:2be4, 5000:2059, 5000:4e7a), subtracts (4000:2bd2), compares for shops (4000:2bb4); town screen shows 0G and the word is 0

fields.name: player.counter_02
fields.meaning: Event counter, decremented by game code
fields.evidence: code 5000:4fb4 decrements side+2 (stride 0x27F); 0 in the save

fields.name: player.counter_03
fields.meaning: Built/town counter (2 in the save; the town screen shows 2/50)
fields.evidence: screen correlation (2/50 shown, byte is 2); no direct code reference

fields.name: player.byte_04
fields.meaning: Unknown (0)
fields.evidence: no code reference found

fields.name: player.tech
fields.meaning: Per-side table starting with 3-byte entries (index*3); count and range unknown
fields.evidence: code 4000:b926 reads [index*3+0x4EE4/0x5163]; all zero except the word at +0x24D

fields.name: player.word_512C
fields.meaning: Unknown word inside the player block tail (0xD7DE, written during the opening)
fields.evidence: no code reference found

fields.name: opponent.money
fields.meaning: Opponent funds in G; set to 100 at chapter start, capped at 9999
fields.evidence: code 5000:9bd0 writes 100, 4000:2be4 adds with cap; value 100 in the save

fields.name: opponent.rest
fields.meaning: Rest of the opponent side block, same layout as the player block (all zero)
fields.evidence: same 0x27F stride in code 5000:4fb4

fields.name: chapter_state.word_53dd
fields.meaning: Chapter progress word (1; cleared at chapter start)
fields.evidence: code 5000:9bd0 clears it

fields.name: chapter_state.word_53df
fields.meaning: Chapter flag word (0; cleared at chapter start)
fields.evidence: code 5000:9bd0 clears it

fields.name: chapter_state.byte_53e1
fields.meaning: Chapter flag byte (0; cleared at chapter start)
fields.evidence: code 5000:9bd0 clears it

fields.name: map_size
fields.meaning: Field map size minus one: width-1, height-1 (0x11, 0x0B = 18x12 tiles)
fields.evidence: matches the map width/height words; written together with the map tiles

fields.name: map_tiles
fields.meaning: Field map terrain in chapter 1, one byte per tile row by row (18x12 = 216; longer in later chapters)
fields.evidence: code writes tiles (built town 0x33 at 4000:055b, army marker 0x32 at 4000:3008) and reads them (5000:390e); the only 0x32 sits exactly under army 0

fields.name: reserved_24cc
fields.meaning: Reserved (all zero in chapter 1 except byte_56c7; later chapters' larger maps may extend into it)
fields.evidence: zero in the verified save

fields.name: byte_56c7
fields.meaning: Unknown byte (0x10, written during the opening)
fields.evidence: no code reference found

fields.name: chapter
fields.meaning: Current chapter 0-4 (game has 5 chapters; 0xFF = no game in progress)
fields.evidence: chapter table 5000:3e93 picked by it (5000:3e44); incremented per chapter, 0xFF wraps to 0 at 4000:4ddb; saved copy of RAM 0x0444

fields.name: flag_445
fields.meaning: Boot/menu flag: the boot code skips the load path when it is 1, then clears it; nothing sets it directly
fields.evidence: code 4000:4dc4 compares with 1, 4000:4dcb clears; no setter found

fields.name: phase
fields.meaning: Phase within the chapter (0-5); Continue resumes at this phase
fields.evidence: ROM jump table 4000:4fa1 with 6 handlers selected by RAM 0x0446 (code 4000:4e08)

fields.name: param_447
fields.meaning: Last event choice/result id, from event scripts
fields.evidence: set from a script call result at 5000:1ff6 and 5000:2012 (RAM 0x0447)

fields.name: income_effect
fields.meaning: Income effect id word: 0xB7 halves opponent income, 0xB9 halves both, 0xBE doubles player income (0xCA also checked)
fields.evidence: code 4000:2c2b compares the word at RAM 0x0448; 0xCA at 5000:4e8c; 0 in the save

fields.name: mode_44a
fields.meaning: Mode word copied from another state word; nonzero selects a branch
fields.evidence: code 4000:89b9 copies RAM 0x040E into 0x044A, 4000:878a tests it, 4000:2c4f clears it

fields.name: map_width
fields.meaning: Field map width in tiles (18; row stride of the tile grid)
fields.evidence: code 5000:3e44 sets header+1 from the chapter map table; tile math uses it (4000:055b, 4000:2fe1)

fields.name: map_height
fields.meaning: Field map height in tiles (12)

fields.name: scroll_x
fields.meaning: Map camera X, 0x180 units per tile
fields.evidence: code 4000:2f22 (cursor-0x300) and the scroll engine 5000:40d2

fields.name: scroll_y
fields.meaning: Map camera Y, 0x180 units per tile
fields.evidence: code 4000:2f22 (cursor-0x180) and 5000:40d2

fields.name: cell_x
fields.meaning: Map cell column of the camera (scroll X / 128)
fields.evidence: code 5000:39c1 compares scroll>>7 with it

fields.name: cell_y
fields.meaning: Map cell row of the camera (scroll Y / 128)
fields.evidence: code 5000:39f8 stores scroll>>7 into it

fields.name: bound_x
fields.meaning: Scroll clamp working value X
fields.evidence: compared and stored by the scroll clamp around 5000:3cb0; 0 in the save

fields.name: bound_y
fields.meaning: Scroll clamp working value Y
fields.evidence: compared and stored by the scroll clamp around 5000:3cb0; 0 in the save

fields.name: render_cell_x
fields.meaning: Transient redraw scratch: cell column being drawn (scroll>>7 + offset); the value at save time is incidental (29)
fields.evidence: code 5000:3950 recomputes it for every drawn cell

fields.name: render_cell_y
fields.meaning: Transient redraw scratch: cell row being drawn (20 in the save)

fields.name: remain_x
fields.meaning: Remaining X scroll distance (one tile = 0x180, drained to 0)
fields.evidence: code 5000:3f36 sets 0x180, 5000:40d2 drains it; 0 in the save

fields.name: remain_y
fields.meaning: Remaining Y scroll distance
fields.evidence: code 5000:3f36 and 5000:40d2; 0 in the save

fields.name: cursor_x
fields.meaning: Field map cursor X, 0x180 units per tile
fields.evidence: code 4000:2f22; moving the cursor 2 tiles changed 0x0180 to 0x0480

fields.name: cursor_y
fields.meaning: Field map cursor Y, 0x180 units per tile
fields.evidence: code 4000:2f22; cursor-move diff

fields.name: speed_x
fields.meaning: Horizontal scroll step per frame (0, +32 or -32)
fields.evidence: code 5000:3f36 sets +/-0x20, 5000:40d2 adds it; 0 in the save

fields.name: speed_y
fields.meaning: Vertical scroll step per frame
fields.evidence: code 5000:3f36 and 5000:40d2; 0 in the save

fields.name: unused_tail
fields.meaning: Unused, always zero, but included in the checksum
fields.evidence: the writer stops at 0x27CC (5000:32fb); init zeroes 0x0000-0x2FFD (5000:3180)

fields.name: unused_gap
fields.meaning: Unused, outside the checksum
fields.evidence: the checksum loop ends at 0x2FFB (5000:314e)

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum: 16-bit sum of words 0x0000-0x2FFB, rotated right by (low byte of the sum) bits
fields.evidence: code 5000:314e/5000:316e; recomputed over all 110 save images in the play tree

fields.name: work_area
fields.meaning: Not part of the save: the live campaign copy (0x3001-0x5794 is what gets saved) plus scratch; 0x3000 is a live flag byte (bit 3 set by one save path, 0 in all observed states)
fields.evidence: code 5000:32fb/5000:3373 copy between 0x3001 and 0x0011
